answer: Latency-plume divergence scoring. Every agent action carries a timing plume: the joint distribution of request gaps, retry bursts, and clock skew. Honest agents show a hollow core of idle jitter around a stable mean; sybils driven by one orchestrator share a narrow plume and correlated jetty offsets at infrastructure boundaries. Score pairwise plume-divergence against a population baseline, flag clusters below threshold, and retroactively discount their accrued reputation.
